_howto: Add a project here and the README grid rebuilds itself. Optional per-project keys: "url" overrides the GitHub link; "note" renders a director's-commentary dropdown under the grid. Drop a recorded clip at assets/demos/<repo>.gif and it appears above that project's card automatically — see .github/workflows/demotape.yml.

projects.name: demotape
projects.blurb: You describe the flow. Playwright performs it against your real app, records it, captions it, and posts the demo straight to the PR.

projects.name: Jacket Studio
projects.blurb: Design flat panels with Photoshop-style tools, watch them wrap onto a rotatable 3D garment, export print-ready artwork.

projects.name: Blueprint Generator
projects.blurb: Turns reference photos into detailed Minecraft builds — 3D preview, block-level editing, Litematica export.

projects.name: caspr
projects.blurb: Hold a key, speak, release. Polished text lands at your cursor in any Windows app. Local Whisper, so audio never leaves the machine.

projects.name: AeroVertex
